title: Oral heritage of Gelede

title: Koutammakou, the Land of the Batammariba

title: Royal Court of Tiébélé

title: Cultural space of the Yaaral and Degal

title: Cultural practices and expressions linked to the M’Bolon
relevantClaim: The M’Bolon is a southern Malian string instrument with a calabash sound box and varied social, agricultural and ceremonial uses.

title: Knowledge, know-how and practices pertaining to the production and consumption of couscous

title: Practices and expressions of joking relationships in Niger

title: Practices and knowledge linked to the Imzad

title: Traditional skills of loincloth weaving in Côte d’Ivoire

title: Gbofe of Afounkaha

title: Cultural space of Sosso-Bala

title: Bolama-Bijagós

relevantClaim: The Bolama-Bijagós Biosphere Reserve is an 88-island Guinea-Bissau archipelago where island communities combine farming, fishing and shell gathering.

title: The zaffa in the traditional wedding

relevantClaim: A rooster-head Akan goldweight is associated with a proverb advising an appropriate, proportionate response to a situation.
